categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in poultry farming, focusing on raising laying hens and selling fresh eggs and processed egg products. It also engages in feed production, fertilizer manufacturing, food processing including frozen and baked goods, and retail and wholesale of agricultural and livestock products. Additionally, it has expanded into egg washing, packaging, cold storage, and frozen food processing through subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced breeding techniques using internationally recognized breeding stock and follows strict feeding, environmental, and immunization protocols to optimize egg production. It uses fully automated closed water curtain poultry houses with environmental controls and automated egg collection and manure handling systems. Quality control is ensured through HACCP, CAS, and ISO22000 certifications, with automated egg washing, UV sterilization, and traceability via egg marking and cold chain logistics.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major retail chains, supermarkets, convenience stores, food processing manufacturers, and restaurant chains such as McDonald's and Mitsui Group in Taiwan. The company targets mid-to-high-end egg markets with branded eggs, functional eggs (e.g., lutein-enriched), and processed egg products. The domestic market in Taiwan is the primary geographic market served.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and sales are concentrated in Taiwan, with production facilities located mainly in Pingtung, Tainan, Yunlin, and other regions. The company collaborates with Japanese partners for product development and aims to expand into Japanese foodservice channels. There is no indication of overseas sales or operations beyond Taiwan and Japan-related cooperation.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the poultry supply chain, including breeding, raising laying hens, egg production, processing, packaging, and distribution. It controls feed supply through its parent company and manages egg washing and packaging facilities. It also invests in upstream activities like breeding stock procurement and downstream activities like retail and foodservice sales.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing food safety, expanding branded and functional egg product lines, and increasing market share through channel diversification. R&D focuses on improving eggshell quality, feed nutrition, disease control, and developing new products such as edible-grade fresh eggs and processed egg products. The company also emphasizes sustainability, smart farming technologies, and ESG initiatives including organic fertilizer production and carbon footprint reduction.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the sale of fresh eggs, liquid eggs, and processed egg products to retail and foodservice customers. The company also earns income from feed and fertilizer sales, and through subsidiaries engaged in egg washing, packaging, cold storage, and frozen food processing. It leverages branded product sales and direct control of distribution channels to capture value.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in Taiwan's high-end branded egg market against major players such as DaChan and CP Group subsidiaries. It differentiates through advanced breeding and farming technologies, food safety certifications, and product innovation including animal welfare and functional eggs. The company holds an estimated 1.88% to 2.42% domestic market share with growth potential as it expands capacity and brand recognition.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$1.22 billion, a 6.09% increase from the prior year, with net profit rising by 31.92% to about NT$95.7 million. Total assets grew by 5.19% to NT$2.38 billion, and equity increased by 27.05% to NT$1.71 billion. The company has shown steady growth in revenue and profitability, supported by capital increases and operational expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, safe, and traceable egg products with certifications such as HACCP and ISO22000. It differentiates through advanced automated farming systems, strict biosecurity, and product innovation including functional and animal welfare-certified eggs. Its vertically integrated supply chain and direct control of sales channels enable consistent quality and customer service, reinforcing brand trust and loyalty.
